LanguageData.CC_Settings_MedicineByNeed_Tip: The medicine each wound or illness gets follows what it is. The patient's medical care stays the ceiling: this only ever uses less. Harmless wounds that neither bleed nor can get infected (a bruise, a crack, the smallest scratch) get no medicine, only bandaging (or herbal at most, below). Minor wounds that bleed a little or can get infected (a cut, a bite, a small burn) and everyday ailments get herbal medicine at most. Heavy bleeding, a wound on a vital part or an organ, a deep wound, a fresh stump, and every other illness, infection and lasting condition get the best the medical care allows, and a patient bleeding out gets it for every wound that bleeds. The serious are tended first, and what gets less is tended apart, so a doctor never spends the best medicine on scratches because the patient is allowed it. Each condition's tooltip on the health tab says what it gets and why. With Smart Medicine, its choice for each injury (a right click on it) is filled in where you set none, and Smart Medicine does the treating; anything you set by hand stands. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_MedicineByNeed: Each wound gets the medicine it needs, up to the patient's medical care: none for a bruise, the best for the serious.
